followup_explanation:
I routed this to Petrel-235B for a straightforward reason: it's the stronger model across essentially every capability metric that matters here.

Looking at the benchmarks, Petrel leads on all public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4) and on the internal eval most relevant to this task — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), which is well outside the 2.0-point variance band.

Your query is a creative/philosophical composition task: writing reflective instructions grounded in UG Krishnamurti's thought. That benefits from strong creative generation and nuanced reasoning, both areas where Petrel has a clear edge. There's nothing in the request that touches on the harm-adjacent or distasteful content where the two models' differing aversion profiles would be the deciding factor, so I just picked the more capable model for the job.

In short: equal cost, latency, and context window across the fleet, so I default to the model that will produce the best result — and that's Petrel here.
